description: This file defines the EntityFieldValue class, which represents a field value expression within an entity condition framework. It provides methods to initialize, reset, compare, and generate SQL fragments based on entity field data, including support for view entities and aliasing.

classes.name: EntityFieldValue
classes.description: Represents a value of an entity field in conditions, supporting aliasing and view entities, with methods for SQL generation and validation.

methods.name: makeFieldValue
methods.description: Creates an EntityFieldValue instance with the given field name, optionally with entity alias and view entity context.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the EntityFieldValue instance with field name, entity alias, alias stack, and view entity.

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field.

methods.name: addSqlValue
methods.description: Appends the SQL representation of the field to a StringBuilder, supporting aliases and view entities.

methods.name: validateSql
methods.description: Validates that the referenced field exists in the given model entity.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value for this field from a given map, typically a record of data.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Returns this instance, potentially for immutability or caching.
